seo.title: What is DHI Hair Transplant? | Choi Pen Technique & Benefits
seo.description: Unshaven hair transplantation with DHI (Direct Hair Implantation) technique, recovery process, and Choi implanter pen details.

hero.title: DHI Hair Transplant (Choi Pen)
hero.subtitle: The most advanced hair transplantation method that creates channels and implants hair follicles simultaneously.

blocks.text: DHI (Direct Hair Implantation) is a procedure where hair grafts are implanted directly beneath the scalp without pre-opening channels, using specially developed medical pens known as Choi Implanters.
✨ Key Feature: In the DHI method, channel creation and graft placement are performed in a single motion using the Choi pen.

items: Offers the possibility of an unshaven hair transplant (ideal especially for women and density enhancement).
Lowers the risk of graft loss since the time follicles spend outside the body is minimized.
Allows for higher hair density (number of grafts per square centimeter).
Bleeding and tissue trauma are significantly lower compared to the FUE technique.

blocks.caption: Specialized medical Choi implanter pens used during DHI operations.

blocks.text: What is the Difference Between DHI and FUE?

In the classic FUE technique, channels are pre-cut using blades, and grafts are manually placed into these channels using forceps. In DHI, there is no separate channel creation phase; as soon as the Choi pen needle penetrates the scalp, it directly deposits the hair follicle.

items.q: Can the DHI method be performed without shaving?
items.a: Yes, one of the biggest advantages of the DHI technique is that even if the donor area is trimmed, the receiving area does not need to be completely shaved.

items.q: How many grafts can be implanted with the DHI technique?
items.a: An average of 2,500 to 3,500 grafts can be implanted in a single session. For extensive hair loss, two sessions may be planned.
